title: Mean Energy Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The mean energy of the oscillator must be correctly expressed as a function of temperature.

title: Partition Function Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The derivation of the partition function for the two-dimensional oscillator must be clearly shown.

title: Degenerate Case Reduction
description: Important Criteria: The reduction of the partition function to the degenerate case must be correctly performed.

title: Heat Capacity Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The heat capacity per oscillator must be derived and expressed correctly as a function of temperature.

title: Mean Position Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The mean value of the position x must be calculated and expressed correctly.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for common errors such as missing factors in the partition function or incorrect limits in integrals.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Ensure that all expressions maintain consistent units throughout the calculations.

title: Thermal Limit Consideration
description: Optional Criteria: Consider the implications of the limit kT/hbar omega << 1 in the context of the problem.
